title: Stations of the Cross: Closing Prayer
text:
Dear God, As I follow and study Your life from the time of Your condemnation until Your Crucifixion and death, it is also a time to review my own life and ask for help in those areas where I have not done well. When I find areas where I need help, let me not become discouraged or give in to despair, but rather turn to You as a child to a parent, and humbly ask for Your divine help and guidance. Help me live one day at a time, and never relive the past or worry about the future. Help me accept each day as it comes, and to live it the way that You and I know best. Never let me say, If I had the chance to live
it over, I would do this or that. Knowing myself, if I had the chance, I would probably make the same mistakes again. Help me to live each moment to its fullest, and in the newness of each moment give me comfort of soul and peace of mind.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
